name: Decision-Maker Selector
description: Keep only decision-makers from fetched people records using word-boundary role matching on job titles. Complements the Bright Data LinkedIn-people Search provider: server-side `includes` is a substring match that cannot select titles cleanly (CTO matches 'director'), so role selection happens here, client-side.
usage_notes: Runs on people records (e.g. LinkedIn profiles fetched by Step-3 api-fetcher). Matches each item's title field against a configurable role list using WORD-BOUNDARY regexes, so 'CTO' never matches 'director'/'factory'. Records with null / empty / emoji / slogan titles match nothing and are dropped. Each kept item is annotated with matched_role + matched_pattern for diagnosability. The role list is fully configurable; nothing is baked into code.

options.name: roles
options.label: Roles to keep (one per line: Role | phrase1, phrase2)
options.description: Each line is a role label and the title phrases that identify it. Phrases are matched with word boundaries and case-insensitively, so acronyms are safe (CTO will not match 'director'). Use spelled-out AND acronym forms. Leave blank for the built-in default (CEO, CTO, CMO, CPO, Founder/Co-Founder, Head of X, VP X, Director of X).
options.default:
CEO | CEO, Chief Executive
CTO | CTO, Chief Technology, Chief Technical
CMO | CMO, Chief Marketing
CPO | CPO, Chief Product
Founder | Founder, Co-Founder
Head | Head of
VP | VP, Vice President
Director | Director of

options.name: title_field
options.label: Item field holding the job title
options.description: Which pool-item field carries the person's title. api-fetcher maps LinkedIn `position` to `title` by default.
